method: Each definition in s25-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun; other failing rows are recorded. The integration files run the real route handler POST /api/v1/buyer/assistant, the /buy page and the add-demo-iced-teas operator function on local PostgreSQL databases built from the migrations through 0026, with DATABASE_URL removed; OpenAI and Envoi's public API are faked at the fetch boundary by tests/support/fake-openai.ts and fake-envoi-api.ts, labeled FIXTURE, so no model is called and PayPal is never reached. The unit file reads src/integrations/assistant, the route and clients/buyer-agent. Every definition here is an S25 test recorded in 00-status.md.
